key_provisions_or_claims: Classifies unmanned aircraft by weight (five types), control method and purpose.
Requires licences for import/export and certificates of eligibility for manufacture, repair and trading of aerial vehicles.
Operators need registration, and pilot licences (Class A visual, Class B instrument rating) valid 10 years.
Flight permits required, with exemptions for small recreational drones; military and public security may suspend, neutralize or detain violating vehicles.
Allocates responsibilities to Ministries of National Defense, Public Security, Construction and others; replaces Decree 36/2008.
annotation.summary_en: Vietnam's Decree 288/2025/ND-CP regulates unmanned aircraft and other aerial vehicles: import/export licensing, manufacturer and trader eligibility certificates, registration, pilot licensing, flight permits, and enforcement powers including suppression and detention, with defense and public security ministries leading. It replaces Decree 36/2008.
